messages:
mike.sullivan: Handing off Evergreen Biotech trial to CS + Support + Eng. Quick context in thread.

mike.sullivan: Trial started last week (30 seats). Use-case: clinical summarization + routing (chat + embeddings). Pilot target: 5 clinician teams.

mike.sullivan: Signals: ~5k tokens/day, intermittent timeouts on ~1.5k token summaries, EU-only data residency request, Okta SSO pending, mentioned Dedicated later in year. Renewal ~90 days.

mike.sullivan: Risks: latency on long-context, some hallucination on structured outputs, legal needs data flow for HIPAA.

mike.sullivan: Asks: CS to lead onboarding & SSO; Support to triage timeouts and propose config; Eng to outline EU/Dedicated options + compliance artifacts.

ashley.cho: Picking up onboarding. I'll schedule 60min kickoff, gather Okta metadata, and prep pilot success metrics. Owner: ashley. Deadline: confirm SSO path in 7 business days.

mike.sullivan: Sent Okta idp metadata to ashley + legal via email. SCIM preferred but not required for pilot.

rana.khan: Support: need a sample request that timed out and the model/version. Mike, please share sample.

mike.sullivan: Sample at /shared/evergreen/timeout_sample.txt. They call redwood-2-medium-prod via hosted. Timeouts around 90s for ~1.5k gen tokens.

rana.khan: I'll repro on staging and check client SDK timeout & batching. Assigning myself; ETA: first repro by EOD tomorrow.

tom.lee: Eng note: we've observed increased tail latency for long-context tenant patterns. Short-term mitigations: streaming + chunked summaries, recommend lower-latency model variant, or tweak request timeouts. Long-term: Dedicated or Private EU deployment. Can run perf profile if you share sample.

tom.lee: For HIPAA/legal artifact: Eng can produce data flow diagram and logs export template; need legal owner to intake.

ashley.cho: CS action list: schedule kickoff (ashley), confirm Okta/SCIM, create pilot metrics doc, open legal intake for HIPAA review. I'll loop in legal.

rana.khan: Support action list: reproduce timeout (rana), share workaround (streaming/chunking + SDK snippet), open ticket SUP-5123 and link. If root cause is kernel-level, I'll escalate to tom.

tom.lee: Eng action list: perf profile (tom) in 3 business days, options doc for EU/Dedicated timeline (tom) in 5 days, compliance artifact for legal in 5 days. Estimate: Dedicated ~4-6 weeks, Private VPC EU ~6-8 weeks (legal + infra).

legal-bot: Reminder: Please file compliance intake with HIPAA checklist and attach Eng data flow doc when available.

mike.sullivan: Commercial note: economic committee review ~60 days, price-sensitive. Pilot must show latency & accuracy wins. Renewal risk: medium-high.

ashley.cho: I'll set a 30-day adoption checkpoint after kickoff (active users, avg latency, accuracy).

rana.khan: Proposed quick SDK workaround: ```js
// chunked streaming example
const resp = await Redwood.chat.create({
  model: 'redwood-2-medium-prod',
  input: longPrompt,
  stream: true,
  chunk_size: 512,
  max_tokens: 800
});
```

tom.lee: I'll run perf tests and draft the options doc for EU/Dedicated. Also will prepare the technical appendix for legal.

mike.sullivan: Summary & owners: Kickoff (ashley) in 3 days, Support repro (rana) EOD tomorrow, Eng perf (tom) 3 business days, Compliance artifact (tom) 5 days. I'll update sales record and join kickoff.

ashley.cho: Will post kickoff notes and next steps. Looping in legal & enablement. :thumbsup:

rana.khan: Created support ticket SUP-5123 and will add repro steps once verified.

mike.sullivan: Thanks team, closing the handoff here.
